visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Profile row in the right column of a 30/60 split: small round portrait left, linked name and position, orange chevron; whole row linked.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Single-row profile: small round portrait left, linked name and position, chevron; cards-portrait is a 3-up grid of tall portrait navigation cards (under 50% similar)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Person profile row with round portrait, linked name and position

contentPattern.summary: Image-beside-text profile row (repeatable profile item, whole row linked)
contentPattern.structure: one row per profile: [portrait image | name (linked), position]

blockContent.description: Director profile: round portrait, linked name, position

usage: List of one or more people with a round portrait, their name linked to a profile page and their position underneath; the whole row is clickable.
reuseGuidance: Use for staff/director profile rows. Link the name so the whole row becomes a link. Use cards-speaker for long bios with larger photos.
